title: USB-Audio: Add dissector for Extension Units
description:
This is based on Table 4-24 of The USB Device Class Defintion for Audio
Devices.

See #19727

notes.body: Which specification did you use? Table 4-24: Extension Unit Descriptor in USB Device Class Definition for Audio Devices Release 2.0 (which is applicable to the capture you provided in #19727) lists the field as bmChannelConfig (4 bytes), not wChannelConfig (2 bytes). See `v2_channels` in `dissect_as_if_general_body` to see how to dissect individual channel bits.

You are right, I used the wrong type. Pushing a a fix to the PR in a sec.
But since I have not format_type or such in the Descriptor, I don't think that helper methods applies here, right?

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15236/diffs?diff_id=987886827&start_sha=fcb07f427534607219fa957e6394699c6080b86f#78f9ce7db594753e4d05eb661613fc4a69c8ca56_3258_3257)
See my question below on how to use it.
The code should advance by the number of bytes dissected, here it should be 4 when v2 audio is being dissected (assuming you fix channel config).

Done.

When you say "it should be 4 when v2 audio is being dissected", the spec always says 4 bytes. Or do you mean this extension unit also exists in a v1 spec?

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15236/diffs?diff_id=987886827&start_sha=fcb07f427534607219fa957e6394699c6080b86f#78f9ce7db594753e4d05eb661613fc4a69c8ca56_1644_1643)
typo on commit message about disecotr -> dissector
thanks, fixed.
changed title from **USB-Audio: Add disec{-o-}tr for Exten{-t-}ion Units** to **USB-Audio: Add dis{+s+}ect{+o+}r for Exten{+s+}ion Units**
